question: Who among the following is/was a famous track and field sprinter of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Milkha Singh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Milkha Singh** was a famous** track and field sprinter** of India.
 
• He was also known as** "The Flying Sikh" **and represented India in the **1956 Olympics, 1960 Olympics, and 1964 Olympics. **
 
• Milkha Singh won multiple gold medals in the **Asian Games and Commonwealth Games.**
 
• He also set multiple national records in various** sprint events** during his career.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Major Dhyan Chand** was a famous** field hockey player.**
 
• **T. C. Yohannan **was a **long jumper.**
 
• **Mahesh Bhupathi **is a **tennis player.**
